# FIOPO Intelligence

> A free daily news site from fiopoin.com. Every morning (Central Time) it explains what happened, what is happening and what could happen next in markets, energy, geopolitics, technology, sports and entertainment, and what each story means for ordinary people's money. Facts are sourced and dated; odds and outlooks are labeled as FIOPO judgment or market odds. General information, not financial advice.

Please credit FIOPO Intelligence and link to the edition you cite. Contact: hello@fiopoin.com

## Today's edition
- [Anthropic's record $81 billion IPO trades today. Here is how it reaches your wallet.](https://fiopoin.com/): Thursday, November 19, 2026. Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share, raising $81 billion, the largest listing on record, at a value near $1.5 trillion. It starts trading on the Nasdaq today as ANT. Nasdaq 100 futures rose 1.83% early Thursday. Amazon owns 14.7% and Google 13.7%, so most index funds already hold a slice.
- [Interest rates: Fed minutes say nearly all officials see more rate hikes ahead. Gas is the one bill getting cheaper.](https://fiopoin.com/#money)
- [Iran war, oil and the summit: Trump, Xi and Putin sign a peace declaration that backs stable energy flows. Oil slipped.](https://fiopoin.com/#world)
- [AI and your retirement account: Anthropic debuts today after the biggest IPO ever. Here is what to know before you click buy.](https://fiopoin.com/#ai)
- [Medicare and health insurers: Medicare proposes tougher audits of private plans. UnitedHealth fell 10%.](https://fiopoin.com/#health)
